title: South Florida plans this week: openings, sales, and one rocket
igCaption:
New openings, a stadium sale, and a rocket week in Florida.
Oct. 21 at Nu Stadium

Sources: Miami New Times, Inter Miami CF, WSVN 7News, Eater Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #MiamiFood

scenes.text: Need plans this week? Start with the new openings, a stadium sale, and one Florida rocket launch.
Trader Joe’s is opening three new Florida stores in 2026 and 2027. Boynton Beach gets its first location at 334 N. Congress Ave., Unit B, in 2027. Orlando and Sarasota are also on the list.
scenes.caption: Trader Joe’s is opening 3 new Florida stores in 2026 and 2027. Boynton Beach gets its first location at 334 N. Congress Ave., Unit B, in 2027.

scenes.text: Inter Miami CF’s Merch Madness sale is Wednesday, Oct. 21, at Nu Stadium. The club says it is its biggest sale of the year.

scenes.text: SpaceX launched the Bandwagon 5 mission Tuesday morning from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The Falcon 9 rocket carried several satellites. If you’re at Cape Canaveral, open NEAR and see who else watched it.

scenes.text: For dinner, Eater added Fooq’s in Little River to its October 2026 Miami 38 list. The restaurant reemerged in Little River with a Persian-inspired menu.
